insertions.question: So pardon my naivete here. What’s the, what are the issues and pain points with smaller containers of the same product?

How many, how many trips per item? Like, what's your model? Like should a bar like that last me for? This is a huge issue in our family. So you have me on the market size already in that particular, because this is an issue in our household. I won't say more than that. But um what, what's your model for how often someone should replenish it? And what your customers expect in terms of uses per turn?

I'm doing some back of the envelope math. If this lasts three to four turns, let's say. I don't know how many trips the average person goes on, I can't imagine it's many more than that, is someone just buying this once a year?
Are there comps of other brands who have done really well in the travel market? Just my initial concerns are people aren't going to buy enough because they don't travel enough.
Can you talk us through um your customer acquisition strategy? You know, after the launch, and really how marketing is going to play out.
